method: Deterministic direct samples of the production adaptive resolution controller; these are threshold tests, not GPU benchmarks.

checks.name: Stable 60 Hz keeps the original resolution
A brief 500 ms frame spike cannot downgrade the scene
Sustained slow frames gradually reduce resolution without crossing the minimum
Recovery waits through short bursts of fast frames
Sustained fast frames recover in bounded steps and stop at the original maximum
Background gaps and impossible short intervals do not alter the budget
Reset applies the new viewport maximum and clears pressure history
Neutral frame windows interrupt the sustained slow threshold
